llc.formation_notes: $50 filing fee + $1 State Archives fee; expedited review +$25. Certified copy $10 + $0.25/page.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: during the calendar quarter of the LLC's registration date (Q1 Jan-Mar, Q2 Apr-Jun, Q3 Jul-Sep, Q4 Oct-Dec)
annual_report.late_penalty: $10 late fee per year delinquent (online); fee schedule shows $15 for paper filing

state_tax_on_llc.name: General excise tax (GET) on gross income
state_tax_on_llc.applies: any business, including a single-member LLC or sole proprietor, on gross receipts from professional services, retailing, etc.
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Gross receipts tax, not an income tax: 4% (0.5% wholesale); plus 0.5% county surcharge in all four counties; one-time $20 GET license fee

personal_exemption.notes: $1,144 per exemption (deduction); MFJ = 2 x $1,144. Head of household standard deduction $12,000 in 2026.

income_tax_2026.starting_point: own definition (federal AGI-based with Hawaii adjustments)
income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None. Act 46 SLH 2024: 2026 keeps the 2025 brackets and raises the standard deduction; brackets widen again in 2027 and 2029. Capital gains taxed at max 7.25% (not verified today).

estimated_tax.notes: Hawaii uses the 20th, not the 15th; Form N-200V. Returns due April 20.

unemployment_2026.notes: Schedule C for 2026; max 5.60%; plus 0.01% Employment & Training assessment

local_taxes.place: All four counties (Honolulu, Kauai, Hawaii, Maui)
local_taxes.name: County surcharge on general excise tax
local_taxes.applies: gross receipts taxed at the 4% GET rate, including professional services of freelancers
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: not applied to 0.5% (wholesale) or 0.15% activities; effective through Dec 31, 2030
local_taxes.quote: County of Maui: The county surcharge at the rate of 0.5% is effective from January 1, 2024

notable: Freelancers pay 4% general excise tax plus 0.5% county surcharge on gross receipts in addition to income tax (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/pubs/25outline.pdf)
Top income tax rate 11%, among the highest; brackets start very low (1.4% up to $9,600 single) (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/announce/ann24-03.pdf)
Standard deduction nearly doubled for 2026 to $8,000 / $16,000 (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/announce/ann24-03.pdf)
Estimated payments and annual returns fall on the 20th (April 20) rather than the 15th (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/pubs/25outline.pdf)
uncertain: tax.hawaii.gov rate schedule pages and capitol.hawaii.gov HRS pages were not readable (404 / Cloudflare); 2026 brackets taken from DOTAX Announcement 2024-03 (Act 46). HB 2306 (2026 session) proposed higher top rates after 2026; not checked whether enacted, it would not affect 2026.
Annual report fee: $12.50 online per a DCCA release originally from 2022 (page updated 2026); BREG fee table lists $15.00. Used $12.50.
Estimated tax threshold not verified; due dates from the July 2025 tax outline.
